sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated-GGUF · Models
sources.snippet: What is Abliteration? This model has the "refusal direction" removed from its weights, allowing unrestricted conversations. The abliteration technique projects out the refusal direction from self_attn.o_proj and mlp.down_proj weights across all layers. See douyamv/Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated for details.
